'''Skystinger''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After [[Bors Teraud]] betrayed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he became a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Warrens Assault Squad]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Captain Skystinger frequently piloted a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/ln starfighter]] in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]].<ref name="SWG:DS" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempGenericPirate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Captain Skystinger]]
Skystinger appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Captain Skystinger was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DS" />
